lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white blobs arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical diffuse bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a subtle grid-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity above and shadow below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, angular V-shaped white scar or depigmented lesion is visible on the upper lateral flank, dorsal to the primary spot rows.
other_distinctive_markers: Intense caustic light reflections from surface water refraction are overlaid across the surface of the visible pectoral fin.
